shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | node -e \"process.stdin.resume(); let d=''; process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c); process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d); console.log('version:',j.version)})\""

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"export.*Modal|interface ModalProps|type ModalProps|open|onClose|footer|children\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts 2>/dev/null || rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg -i 'modal.*\\.d\\.ts"'$|button.*'"\\.d\\.ts"'$'"' | head -40"
/bin/bash -lc "cat src/App.tsx; echo '--- main.tsx ---'; cat src/main.tsx; echo '--- index.html ---'; cat index.html"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"Dialog|Modal\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/index.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo '--- find index ---'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | head"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"Dialog\\b\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/Dialog/Dialog.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; rg -n \"DialogFooter\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/Dialog/Dialog.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo '=== exports from Dialog ==='; rg \"exports\\.\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/Dialog/Dialog.js | head -5"
